query:
SELECT bel.entity_type, bel.entity_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, bs.source_type
FROM bibliography_entity_links bel
JOIN bibliography_sources bs ON bs.id = bel.bibliography_id
WHERE bs.source_type = 'openalex'
GROUP BY bel.entity_type, bs.source_type
LIMIT 5;

SELECT bel.entity_type, bel.entity_id, bs.title
FROM bibliography_entity_links bel
JOIN bibliography_sources bs ON bs.id = bel.bibliography_id
WHERE bs.source_type = 'openalex'
LIMIT 5;
